sentences.text: No, the documents do not state that the lender must offer EMI-based personal loan borrowers the option to switch to a fixed rate at reset; they state that the REs "may, at its option," provide that choice as per their Board approved policy.
The applicable reset rule is for "EMI based floating rate personal loans" and covers the time of reset of interest rates.
The documents also state that the policy may specify the number of times a borrower will be allowed to switch during the tenor of the loan, if such an option is provided.
